rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) with a lockfile-keyed actions/cache for deps/_build plus restore keys, so no cache change is needed. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true) is not safe to apply because the matrix tests distinct Elixir/OTP/database combinations; canceling a remaining matrix job after a failure would lose version-specific coverage and diagnostics, and required-check status is unverified (contraindication: every matrix outcome may be required). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be applied safely because the CI history is marked not_a_measured_baseline/historical_context_only with variable successful-run durations, so no representative timeout budget exists (contraindication: valid slow runs may exceed the limit). Other patterns are ci_service/build_configuration scope or have contraindications that apply. No supported change preserves intended build and test coverage.
